uv: UV is radiation lying in the ultraviolet range.
UV means the same as ultraviolet or ultraviolet radiation or ultraviolet light.
uvea: An uvea is the part of the eye that contains the iris and ciliary body and choroid.
uveitis: Uveitis is inflammation of the uvea of the eye.
uveoscleral pathway: An uveoscleral pathway is a tubule that drains excess aqueous humor.
uvula: An uvula is a small pendant fleshy lobe at the back of the soft palate.
uvularia: Uvularia is genus of perennial rhizomatous herb of southern and southeastern United States.
Uvularia means the same as genus Uvularia.
uvularia grandiflora: Uvularia grandiflora is plant of southern and southeastern United States grown for its yellow flowers that can be dried.
Uvularia grandiflora means the same as strawflower or cornflower.
uvulariaceae: Uvulariaceae is one of many subfamilies into which some classification systems subdivide the Liliaceae.
Uvulariaceae means the same as subfamily Uvulariaceae.
uvulitis: Uvulitis is inflammation of the uvula.
uvulopalatopharyngoplasty: Uvulopalatopharyngoplasty is surgical resection of unnecessary palatal and oropharyngeal tissue to open the airway.
Uvulopalatopharyngoplasty means the same as palatopharyngoplasty or PPP or UPPP.
uveal: Uveal means of or relating to the uvea of the eye.
Uveal means the same as uveous.
uveous: Uveous means of or relating to the uvea of the eye.
Uveous means the same as uveal.
uvular: Uvular means of or relating to or associated with the uvula.
